[[Sarah Natochenny]] ([[SM004]]-[[SM068]]) | }} '''Nurse Joy's Blissey''' (Japanese: '''ジョーイのハピナス''' ''Joy's Happinas'') are {{OBP|Pokémon|species}} owned by [[Nurse Joy]]s in [[Happy Town]], [[Lake Acuity]], and the [[Alola]] [[region]]. ==In animation== ===''Pokémon the Series''=== ====History==== ====={{aniseries|GS}}===== [[File:Nurse Joy Blissey good luck charm.png|thumb|left|220px|Blissey and Jessie putting together the good luck charm]] Sometime prior to ''[[EP129|Ignorance is Blissey]]'', [[Jessie]] met a Blissey from Happy Town as a Chansey. She explains to [[James]] and {{MTR}} that she had studied with the particular Chansey in a [[Pokémon Nurse School]] together, where they had become best friends. Jessie, unfortunately, did not qualify to become a nurse and quit the school, due to the fact that she is not a Pokémon, so she cannot learn the move {{m|Sing}}. Chansey had given part of the medal she had received as a nurse to Jessie so that they could remember each other. {{p|Blissey}} made her first official appearance in ''Ignorance is Blissey''. {{Ash}} and {{ashfr}} had met up with Blissey in the [[Pokémon Center]]. Seeing that they were hungry, she prepared food for them but due to her over-enthusiasm, she spilled the food on them. A well-meaning yet clumsy Pokémon, the more Blissey tried to help, the more problems she caused. When {{TRT}} tried to steal food from the center, Jessie met Blissey and they immediately recognized each other. Blissey then gave Team Rocket most of the food in the pantry. The others in the Pokémon Center soon found out and everyone blamed Blissey. Wanting to help her friend, Jessie pretended that she had tricked Blissey into giving them the food. She also faked attacking her to make Nurse Joy and the others believe her. They were soon [[Blasting off|thrown out]], but not before Jessie whispered to her friend Blissey to keep it a secret. ====={{aniseries|DP}}===== The Blissey from Happy Town reappeared in Jessie's flashback during ''[[DP038|One Big Happiny Family!]]''. Another Blissey appeared in ''[[DP133|Uncrushing Defeat!]]'', where she was seen with Nurse Joy in the Pokémon Center near [[Lake Acuity]]. She, along with Nurse Joy and Chansey, healed {{cat|Ash's Pokémon}} after Ash lost to [[Paul]] in their [[Full Battle]]. Blissey was later seen watching a show {{an|Dawn}} put on with {{cat|Dawn's Pokémon|her Pokémon}}. She then watched as Ash took on Team Rocket and his Pokémon combined their attacks to blast Team Rocket off. ====={{aniseries|SM}}===== [[File:Nurse Joy and Blissey.png|thumb|250px|Nurse Joy and her Blissey]] In the [[Alola]] region, Blissey is one of Nurse Joy's main Pokémon, alongside {{TP|Nurse Joy|Comfey}}. She first appeared with Nurse Joy in ''[[SM004|First Catch in Alola, Ketchum-Style!]]'', where she helped treat [[Ash's Pikachu]]. In ''[[SM068|Real Life...Inquire Within!]]'', Blissey assisted Ash and {{ashcl}} when they were on work experience at the [[Pokémon Center]]. ====Personality and characteristics==== The Blissey from [[Happy Town]] was shown to be very clumsy, as seen when she fell after trying to give food to {{Ash}} and {{ashfr}}. Despite that, the Happy Town Blissey had a good friendship with [[Jessie]] as they studied together in a [[Pokémon Nurse School]] when Blissey was a Chansey. Despite the fact that Chansey graduated from the school whereas Jessie didn't, their friendship stayed as Chansey gave Jessie half of the egg-shaped pendent to remember each other by. By the time Jessie got to reunite with Chansey who was now a Blissey, they were both happy to see each other and Jessie did everything she can to keep Blissey out of trouble. Similar to the other recurring Pokémon that Nurse Joy have, both the Blissey from Happy Town and the other Blissey were shown to be very helpful. ===Appearance=== {| style="margin:auto; text-align:center; background: #{{normal color}}; {{roundy}}; border: 3px solid #{{normal color dark}}" |- ! style="background:#{{normal color light}}; {{roundytop|5px}}" | As a Chansey |- style="background:#fff" | [[File:Jessie Chansey.png|220px]] |} ====Moves used==== {{anmov/h|normal||Nurse Joy Chansey Sing.png|Using Sing as a
